Iran's Nuclear Chief Blocked From Vienna Meeting Amid US Objections

Iran's nuclear chief, Mohammad Eslami, was reportedly blocked from attending a meeting in Vienna. Austria prevented his entry after the United States objected to a travel exemption for him. The meeting was related to Iran's nuclear program. Iran has denounced Austria's decision, calling it a violation of diplomatic norms. The incident occurred as international discussions regarding Iran's nuclear activities continue.
